notes: The wordpress_container slug keeps Docker WordPress distinct from the native PHP installer; the two are filtered by server stack.
WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA trusts the proxy forwarded protocol to avoid mixed content and redirect loops. Literal PHP variables are escaped with $$ for Compose.
WP_HOME and WP_SITEURL follow the panel domain through WORDPRESS_SITE_URL instead of leaving a changed domain locked to old database values.
The image generates and stores WordPress salts in wp-config.php in the app volume. MariaDB has its own volume and separate root and application passwords.
